xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2616: closed-issue reaper is blind to Linear-tracked issues — isTrackerIssueClosed returns false for any non-GitHub issue

plan.title: closed-issue reaper is blind to Linear-tracked issues — isTrackerIssueClosed returns false for any non-GitHub issue
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: isTrackerIssueClosed (src/lib/cloister/issue-closed.ts:27-31) short-circuits to false for any issue that does not resolve to a GitHub repo, so Linear-tracked issues (MIN-*, AUR-*) never look closed unless shadow state happens to say done/canceled. The closed-issue reaper therefore never reaps their residue: tmux sessions, workspaces, and Docker _devnet networks leak until manual cleanup (evidence 2026-07-12: MIN-729/861/862 Done in Linear, myn-feature-min-*_devnet networks persisted for days).
narratives.Proposal: Add a Linear branch to isTrackerIssueClosed mirroring the GitHub branch: when the issue's project resolves to the Linear tracker AND a configured project, query the Linear API through the existing LinearTracker adapter (client via createTracker({type:'linear'}) with getLinearApiKey() fallback), map normalized state 'closed' (Linear completed/canceled) to closed, guard on issue.ref equality against fuzzy search, bound the lookup with a 10s Effect.timeout, resolve every ambiguous outcome to false, and cache all outcomes for the existing 5-minute TTL. Full decision rules and before/after snippets are in the PRD draft (drafts/pan-2616.md on overdeck-state).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No Rally or GitLab closed-detection support; those tracker types keep returning false
- No changes to shadow-state writing at merge/close time (rejected alternative)
- No changes to isIssueClosed ordering, reconcileClosedIssueAgents, reapIssueResidue, or cache TTL semantics
- No new configuration surface; existing Linear key sources only (config.yaml trackerKeys.linear, LINEAR_API_KEY, ~/.overdeck.env)

autoDecisions.summary: Chose the direct Linear API check in isTrackerIssueClosed over the shadow-state-write alternative offered by the issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: Shadow-state writes only cover Overdeck-initiated closes; the evidence issues were closed directly in the Linear UI, so the tracker check must observe external closes.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate the Linear lookup on resolveTrackerTypeSync === 'linear' AND resolveProjectFromIssueSync non-null.
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveTrackerTypeSync falls back to 'linear' for unknown prefixes; requiring a configured project prevents fuzzy Linear API searches for junk IDs and preserves current false behavior for rally/gitlab/unknown.

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve the Linear client via createTracker({type:'linear'}) first, falling back to getLinearApiKey() + new LinearTracker(key).
autoDecisions.rationale: createTracker covers config.yaml Settings key and LINEAR_API_KEY env; getLinearApiKey covers ~/.overdeck.env — the union covers all three key sources in the codebase.

autoDecisions.summary: Require issue.ref case-insensitive equality with the requested issueId before reporting closed, bound the lookup with a 10s timeout, and resolve every error/ambiguity to false cached for the full TTL.
autoDecisions.rationale: LinearTracker.getIssue resolves identifiers via fuzzy searchIssues; the reaper is destructive, so false positives must be structurally impossible while false negatives only delay reaping by one patrol.

items.title: Extend isTrackerIssueClosed with a Linear tracker branch

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/issue-closed.ts, replace the body of the !resolved.isGitHub short-circuit (lines 27-31) with a call to a new isLinearIssueClosed(issueId) helper whose result is cached in trackerClosedCache and returned. Implement the helper exactly per PRD WI-1: (1) return false unless resolveTrackerTypeSync(issueId) === 'linear' (src/lib/tracker-utils.ts) and resolveProjectFromIssueSync(issueId) (src/lib/projects.ts) is non-null; (2) build the tracker via createTracker({ type: 'linear' }) (src/lib/tracker/factory.ts) inside try/catch, falling back to getLinearApiKey() (src/lib/shadow-utils.ts) + new LinearTracker(key) (src/lib/tracker/linear.ts), returning false when no key resolves; (3) run tracker.getIssue(issueId) with Effect.timeout('10 seconds') via Effect.runPromise; (4) return issue.state === 'closed' && issue.ref?.toUpperCase() === issueId.toUpperCase(); (5) catch all errors (including timeout and IssueNotFoundError) and return false. Do not modify isIssueClosed, the GitHub branches, the cache structure, or TRACKER_CLOSED_CACHE_TTL_MS. No sync child-process calls.

items.title: Given a Linear-tracked issue whose mocked/normalized tracker state is 'closed' (Linear completed or canceled), isTrackerIssueClosed returns true and caches the verdict in trackerClosedCache
Given no Linear API key resolvable from createTracker or getLinearApiKey, isTrackerIssueClosed returns false without invoking tracker.getIssue
Given an issue resolving to rally/gitlab tracker type or to no configured project, isTrackerIssueClosed returns false without constructing a Linear client (preserves pre-change behavior)
Given the Linear lookup errors, exceeds the 10-second timeout, or returns an issue whose ref differs case-insensitively from the requested id, isTrackerIssueClosed returns false and caches false
npm run typecheck exits 0 and npm run build exits 0, demonstrating the new tracker-factory import produces no type errors and no circular ESM import failures
Unit tests for the Linear closed-detection branch

expected_outputs: issue-closed.test.ts suite passes with new Linear-branch tests and all pre-existing GitHub-path tests green

narrative.Action: Extend src/lib/cloister/__tests__/issue-closed.test.ts following its existing vi.hoisted + vi.mock pattern. Add resolveTrackerTypeSync to the existing ../../../lib/tracker-utils.js mock, and add mocks for ../../../lib/projects.js (resolveProjectFromIssueSync), ../../../lib/tracker/factory.js (createTracker), ../../../lib/tracker/linear.js (LinearTracker), and ../../../lib/shadow-utils.js (getLinearApiKey). Cover the seven cases from PRD WI-2: closed-state true; no-key false without getIssue; rally-type and null-project false without client construction; TTL cache hit then re-query after advancing past TRACKER_CLOSED_CACHE_TTL_MS using vi.useFakeTimers()/vi.setSystemTime() (never real waits — repo fake-timers rule); getIssue rejection false; ref-mismatch false. Keep all existing GitHub-path tests passing unchanged; call clearIssueClosedCache() in beforeEach as the file already does. No network access anywhere.

items.title: A test asserts a mocked Linear issue with normalized state 'closed' and matching ref produces true from isTrackerIssueClosed, with zero real network calls
Given the missing-key, rally-tracker-type, unresolved-project, getIssue-error, and ref-mismatch paths, isTrackerIssueClosed returns false in each, and gated paths never invoke getIssue
Given fake timers, a second call within TRACKER_CLOSED_CACHE_TTL_MS returns the cached verdict without a second getIssue call, then a call after the TTL re-queries the tracker
The full issue-closed.test.ts suite passes, including every pre-existing GitHub-path and shadow-state test unchanged
